name: 71234 · Downsville, LA
findings: ZIP 71234 (Downsville) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 71234 (Downsville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
